query:
SELECT 
  c.id,
  c.nome,
  c.empresaSlug,
  c.cashbarberProfissionalId,
  COUNT(f.id) as qtd_lancamentos,
  SUM(CAST(f.cat1 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(f.cat2 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(f.cat3 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + 
      CAST(f.cat4 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(f.cat5 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(f.cat6 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) +
      CAST(f.cat7 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(f.cat8 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(f.cat9 AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as total_faturamento
FROM colaboradores c
LEFT JOIN faturamentos f ON c.id = f.colaboradorId AND MONTH(STR_TO_DATE(f.data, '%Y-%m-%d')) = 5 AND YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(f.data, '%Y-%m-%d')) = 2026
WHERE c.id = 150002
GROUP BY c.id, c.nome, c.empresaSlug, c.cashbarberProfissionalId;
